operations.summary: Fit (sigma_E/E)^2 = a^2/E + b^2/E^2 + c^2 to (E, sigma_E/E[, uncertainty]) points by exact linear least squares (weighted by the input uncertainties, else by a constant relative uncertainty), or evaluate given a, b, c; reports the per-term breakdown, the dominant term and the crossover energies

inputs.name: fit
inputs.constraint: JSON object with a points list [[E, sigma_E/E(, uncertainty)], ...]; sigma_E/E a fraction (<= 1); at least three distinct energies; excludes --evaluate

inputs.name: evaluate
inputs.constraint: evaluate the given coefficients instead of fitting; excludes --fit

inputs.name: valid_range
inputs.constraint: evaluate: LOW HIGH of the fitted range, LOW <= HIGH

inputs.name: status
inputs.constraint: one of the core artifact_statuses; echoed as status (default: the --fit file's status, else unvalidated)

failure_states.meaning: the fit input is unreadable or invalid, or a squared coefficient fitted negative (all roots null, ok false, the reason in warnings), or the result is not representable
an argument is missing, malformed or out of range; stdout carries {"status": "failed", "ok": false, "error_kind": "invalid-input", "error": ...} and stderr the usage and one error line
